# Streak CRM | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Word location | Pipeline CRM directly running in Gmail to embed sales, recruitment, financing, etc. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | Reliance on Google ecology; limited complex object models, full-source communications and large enterprise analysis; all visible users required permission. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, award or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Reliance on Google ecology; limited complex object models, full-source communications and large enterprise analysis; all visible users required permission. |
